t.why: The only South American country that still recognizes Taiwan. It runs the Itaipu Dam jointly with Brazil.
t.rel: A landlocked country between Brazil and Argentina. It runs the giant Itaipu hydropower plant with Brazil and the Yacyreta Dam with Argentina, selling electricity. It is a founding member of Mercosur.
t.korea: Many Korean immigrants have settled there since the 1960s.
t.know: Thanks to Itaipu, built with Brazil, nearly all of Paraguay's electricity comes from hydropower.
t.etext: It sells soybeans and beef, and electricity from giant hydropower plants to Brazil and Argentina. Taxes are on the low side.
